description: This file defines a Java interface for accessing 'Answer' entities in a database using Spring Data JPA. It extends JpaRepository and includes a custom method to find answers by question ID.

classes.name: AnswerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for 'Answer' entities, including a custom method to retrieve answers by question ID.

methods.name: findByQuestionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Answer objects associated with a specific question ID.
